This home-style dish mixes fluffy eggs with chopped vegetables for nutritional balance.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Vegetable Omelets by [[Cooking]] a [[Bird Egg]], [[Goat Butter|Goat Butter]], [[Rock Salt]], and any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can be made either by using [[Hyrule Herb]]s, which have no [[Added Effect]]s, or by using Ingredients with contradicting Effects. Eating them will heal some of Link's [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. The use of eggs and chopped Vegetables adds to the nutritional balance of this [[Meal]]. Several different variations of Vegetable Omelets can be made, depending on the type of Vegetable, herb, or Flower used: * '''Hearty Vegetable Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Vegetable Omelet}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This home-style dish mixes fluffy eggs with chopped vegetables for nutritional balance.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Radish]]es, [[Big Hearty Radish]]es, or other hearty Ingredients. By eating them, all of Link's Hearts will be healed and he will gain [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Energizing Vegetable Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Vegetable Omelet}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
This home-style dish mixes fluffy eggs with chopped vegetables for nutritional balance.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using energizing Ingredients. They can be eaten to partially refill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Vegetable Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Vegetable Omelet}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This home-style dish mixes fluffy eggs with chopped vegetables for nutritional balance.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Carrot]]s or other enduring Ingredients. When eaten, they'll completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Vegetable Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Vegetable Omelet}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This home-style dish mixes fluffy eggs with chopped vegetables for nutritional balance.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Swift Carrot]]s, [[Swift Violet]]s, or other hasty Ingredients. These omelets will provide Link with a movement speed when he eats them. * '''Spicy Vegetable Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Vegetable Omelet}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
This home-style dish mixes fluffy eggs with chopped vegetables for nutritional balance.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Warm Safflina]]s or other spicy Ingredients. Consuming them will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Vegetable Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Vegetable Omelet}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
This home-style dish mixes fluffy eggs with chopped vegetables for nutritional balance.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Electric Safflina]]s or other electric Ingredients. If eaten, they give Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Vegetable Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Vegetable Omelet}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This home-style dish mixes fluffy eggs with chopped vegetables for nutritional balance.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Thistle]]s or other mighty Ingredients. Eating these omelets will provide Link with a boost to his attack power. * '''Tough Vegetable Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Vegetable Omelet}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This home-style dish mixes fluffy eggs with chopped vegetables for nutritional balance.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s, [[Armoranth]]s, or other tough Ingredients. They will grant Link a boost to his [[Defense]] when he eats them. * '''Sneaky Vegetable Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Vegetable Omelet}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
This home-style dish mixes fluffy eggs with chopped vegetables for nutritional balance.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Blue Nightshade]]s, [[Silent Princess]]es, or other sneaky Ingredients. By eating them, Link will receive a boost to his [[Stealth]]. * '''Chilly Vegetable Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Vegetable Omelet}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
This home-style dish mixes fluffy eggs with chopped vegetables for nutritional balance.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Cool Safflina]]s or other spicy Ingredients. They can be consumed to grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Vegetable Omelets are made by [[Cooking]] any kind of [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]] with a [[Bird Egg]], [[Goat Butter]], and a piece of [[Rock Salt]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Recipe for a Vegetable Omelet is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[The Future of Hyrule]]". It is made using one [[Swift Carrot]], one [[Bird Egg]], one [[Goat Butter]], and one [[Rock Salt]]. [[Cooking]] a Vegetable Omelet before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] increases the amount of experience gained by the [[Warrior]]s by eight percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Vegetable Omelet Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Vegetable Omelet ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Omelets, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
